meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared the agent guides and loopback fixtures with both controller role scopes, exact-slug article passages, the bounded evidence fields, and Chat Completions call correlation and model continuation.

auth.review_note: Reviewed guest, customer and owner tool and conversation boundaries with the shared backend guidance. Article reads enforce the public publication and module checks in both authenticated and guest turns.

commerce.review_note: Compared the shared evidence guidance with order and payment contracts and the separate storefront counts. The article path reads published Markdown and retains only the approved source metadata in its trace.

content.review_note: Compared the published article guide with exact-slug lookup, current publication and module gates, and rendered block and fenced-code whitespace. Campaign download and booking revisions remain governed by their existing guides.

foundation.review_note: Compared the storage and architecture guides with published article evidence, private chat traces and the audit reference. The targeted excerpt stays in provider request context while private traces retain source identity, hashes and position.

google-tags.review_note: Compared Google inference configuration and provider diagnostics with the independent tags, reporting, and authentication settings.

http-errors.review_note: Compared article trace redaction with the private response guard, Chat Completions provider failures and labelled Support reference. A failed turn reports a bounded application trace identifier.

interface.review_note: Compared the Support error reference, keyboard recovery, and owner diagnostic card with the shared layout and both desktop and narrow viewport fixtures.

mail.review_note: Checked the shared article evidence rule against sign-in notice and queue entry points. Published passage reads use BlogService without triggering mail.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the CLI skill change against MCP client guidance. Local CI runs the public storefront search fixture without changing MCP client administration.

media.review_note: Checked retained campaign file descriptors and protected streaming against Media Library behavior. Booking authorization is scoped to the frozen private manifest.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the enterprise and monitoring guides with topic-targeted article evidence in each PHP agent. The stored source ID, digests and optional section position remain distinct from the labelled Support failure reference.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared HTTP, WebMCP and MCP article search with the shared retriever. Their schema and title and summary scoring remain intact, while the native agents opt in to body matching and topic passages.

remote-commerce.review_note: Compared published article retrieval and shared transport against the cart, checkout and campaign dispatch contracts. Article lookup reads published Markdown, and the authenticated storefront count remains an independent database read.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared public search fixture coverage with the product feed and CLI guidance. The fixture verifies published search and module controls using synthetic records.

workflow.review_note: Compared the generated inventories and CLI development guide against the combined tree. Local storefront search stays in CI, and real Support and Enterprise handlers exercise topic article retrieval over Chat Completions fixtures.
